title: 1.4.5 Images of Text Mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q1
elements.title: Why use real text where the criterion applies?
choices: It is more adaptable to user presentation settings
elements.correctAnswer: It is more adaptable to user presentation settings
elements.feedback: Real text generally supports user resizing and styling.

elements.name: q2
elements.title: Does alt text make visible words in an image resize as text?
elements.feedback: Alternative text does not make the graphic words themselves adaptable text.

elements.name: q3
elements.title: Are logotypes considered essential under this criterion?
elements.feedback: Logotypes are considered essential; check the criterion for its scope.
